entries.effect: Keep a source-identifying relation visible across form and state.
entries.risk: Motion or continuity becomes a reusable shell.
entries.test: Ablate the relation and measure identity loss.

entries.effect: Vary a signal within a bounded perceptual range.
entries.risk: Adaptation hides state or makes comparison unstable.
